text: My old laptop suddenly stopped charging last week. Instead of tossing it or buying a new one, I opened the chassis and found a simple blown capacitor on the charging board. I ordered a replacement part for five dollars, and now it's running faster than ever. This is exactly why I love repairable hardware. There is something deeply satisfying about saving a piece of technology from the landfill instead of contributing to the growing problem of e-waste.
